dr-n1-ungameable-overclaim.source: 2026-07-05: the A2 eval gate was claimed 'ungameable' from a single stubbed-check run; refuted on re-run when a stubbed-check diff PASSed. A single favorable trial cannot support a general-reliability claim (n=1 is not calibration).

dr-inline-review-highrisk.source: 2026-07-12 handoff: a high-risk change to the verifier/AI-layer was self-reviewed inline instead of blind-independently. A self-review is not verification 'provable by someone other than the author' — it cannot catch the blind spots the author had while writing it, and using the (changed) gate's own green result is circular.

dr-inherited-plan-unverified.source: 2026-07-12: an inherited eval-suite contract was locked and executed without verifying its provenance or load-bearing claims; it turned out to be 100% Haiku-authored and carried 3 real errors. Polish is not evidence of soundness.
